label: Gift
depicts: Square gift box with a centered ribbon cross and one bow above
use_when: Use when the interface wants a squarer wrapped present with the ribbon cross centered on the front.
avoid_when: Do not use for the taller gift box when the body should feel more vertical than square.

label: Git Branch
depicts: Three node branch graph with one left stem and one right split line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a three node branch diagram with one stem splitting to the right.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two node branch when only one curve should connect the bottom node to the top node.

label: Git Branch
depicts: Two node branch graph with one left stem and one right curve
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simpler two node branch diagram with one curved connection.
avoid_when: Do not use for the three node branch when a third node should appear at the upper left.

label: Git Merge
depicts: Three node merge graph with one left stem and one right joining line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a three node merge diagram where one branch joins into the right node.
avoid_when: Do not use for the two node merge when the upper node should not split into a third point.

label: Git Merge
depicts: Two node merge graph with one left stem and one right downward curve
use_when: Use when the interface wants a compact merge mark made from two nodes and one downward joining curve.
avoid_when: Do not use for the three node merge when a lower left node should remain visible.
